INSERT INTO signal_events (
            source, event_type, headline, description,
            canonical_key, occurred_at, status
         )
         VALUES (
            $1, $2::signal_event_type, $3, $4, $5,
            now() - ($6 * INTERVAL '1 day'),
            'ACTIVE'::signal_event_status
         )
         ON CONFLICT (source, canonical_key) DO UPDATE
             SET headline = EXCLUDED.headline
         RETURNING id
